instruction: in/assets/laptops.txt and in/assets/phones.txt list '<tag> <holder>' lines; holder '-' means unassigned. Write out/by_holder.txt: one line per holder sorted byte-wise (ordinal) ascending by holder name, '<holder> <tag>,<tag>' with tags sorted byte-wise (ordinal) ascending; unassigned tags go under the holder name UNASSIGNED.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
